move: route line draws on, dot rides the extension, new pin pops elastic
how: A cream map (SVG land/water paths) sits inside a .map wrapper that the camera drives: it holds at scale 1.25 with a slow linear pan for the first 35% of the duration, then eases (power2.inOut) out to scale 1.05 and pans down-right to follow the extension. Pins scale in with back.out(3), labels with back.out(2), and the existing route #p1 draws with DrawSVG 0%→100% over ~14% of D (power2.inOut). At 38% a black dot appears and rides #p2 with MotionPath while #p2 draws behind it (both 1.8s, power2.inOut); the dot fades, the orange pin pops with elastic.out(1,0.5), its halo circle pulses r 24→50 with fading opacity repeat 3, then the label, a pill badge (back.out(2.5)) and two masked title lines (yPercent 110→0, expo.out, stagger 0.1) arrive. The last 8% reverses everything with expo.in: title lines exit upward, badge/labels/pins scale to 0, and the routes un-draw to '100% 100%'.
adapt: Replace the three land paths and two route paths with the product's geography, rename the three city labels and title lines, and swap the accent #ff5a36 and map palette; keep the draw/dot/pin/label ordering and the 3.5s camera hold before the pan.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the map SVG, labels, badge and title into el and runs the gsap.set initial states; animate(el, shot, D) builds the same timeline with positions as fractions of D (route 1 draw at 0.06D, extension at 0.38D, reveal at 0.55-0.61D, exit at 0.92D) and returns it. Selectors like '#p1', '.map', '.dot' must be scoped via el.querySelector; MotionPath align expects the SVG in the DOM before the tween is created.
caveats: camera does not return: map ends at scale 1.02 / x-30 / y-70 but starts at scale 1.25 / x120 / y160, so the loop jumps
render.json duration is 10s while the catalog lists 12s
SVG ids #p1/#p2 collide if two instances are mounted
